name: Saint John Paul II
history: Karol Wojtyła, actor, philosopher and bishop of Kraków, was elected pope in 1978, the first non-Italian in 455 years. He helped bring down communism in Eastern Europe, travelled to 129 countries, gave the Church the Theology of the Body and the Catechism, and bore his long final illness in public.
meditation: Do not be afraid. Open wide the doors for Christ. Which door have you kept shut?
